summary: Learn PPP payment, performance, change-control, and fiscal-risk monitoring. Explore the five-day course and practical curriculum.
lede: Post-award public-private partnership (PPP) contract management focuses on overseeing services, payments and risks after a contract is awarded. For PPP-unit officials, contract and procurement managers, utility executives and infrastructure leaders, the course covers mapping obligations, verifying KPIs and payments, managing contract changes, and recording fiscal risks with registers, scorecards and spreadsheet-based analysis.
audienceIntro: PPP contract management training is designed for professionals who oversee infrastructure and public services after contract award, including those responsible for performance, payments, fiscal exposure, and public accountability.
modules: World Bank PPP Reference Guide and Delivery
IMF PFRAM and PPP Fiscal Risks
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with infrastructure projects, public procurement, public finance, utility operations, or contract administration is expected. You do not need prior PPP certification or programming skills. Basic spreadsheet use will support payment and fiscal-risk exercises.
